heading: Regulations for implementation of provisions
lead: The Secretary is authorized to prescribe such regulations as the Secretary determines necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter.

notes.text: Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–334 substituted “The Secretary is” for “The Secretary of Agriculture is”.
Effective DateSection effective Oct. 1, 1978, see section 406 of Pub. L. 95–334, set out as a note under section 2201 of this title.
